steps.instruction: -Iodized Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Iodized Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -In a tarka pan, add coriander, cumin, black peppercorns, green cardamom, star anise, cloves, fennel seeds, dried lemon, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, & dry roast on low flame until fragrant.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek tarka pan mein coriander, cumin, black peppercorns, green cardamom, star anise, cloves, fennel seeds, dried lemon, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves dalein aur halki aanch par khushboo aane tak dry roast karen.

steps.instruction: -Let it cool down & transfer it to a spice grinder.
steps.romanUrdu: -Thanda hone den, phir spice grinder mein transfer karen.

steps.instruction: -Add red chilli powder, pink salt, turmeric powder, kashmiri red chilli powder, grind well, mandi spice mix is ready, set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Red chilli powder, pink salt, turmeric powder, Kashmiri red chilli powder dalein, achi tarah grind karen. Mandi spice mix tayyar hai, side par rakh den.

steps.instruction: -In a flat dish, add (1 tbs) mandi spice mix (reserve for later use), pink salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, kashmiri red chilli powder, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, cooking oil, whisk until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek flat dish mein (1 tbs) mandi spice mix dalein (baqi baad ke liye reserve karen), pink salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, Kashmiri red chilli powder, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, cooking oil dalein aur achi tarah whisk karen.

steps.instruction: -Add Surmai fish pieces & apply marinade, cover with aluminium foil & marinate for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Surmai fish pieces dalein aur marinade achi tarah apply karen.

steps.instruction: -After 30 minutes place marinated fish in a preheated oven & bake for 15-20 minutes at 200 °C then remove foil & bake for 12-15 minutes at 200 °C.
steps.romanUrdu: -Aluminium foil se cover karen aur 30 minutes ke liye marinate karen.
-30 minutes baad marinated fish ko preheated oven mein rakh den aur 200°C par 15–20 minutes bake karen, phir foil remove karen aur dobara 200°C par 12–15 minutes bake karen.

steps.instruction: -In a blending jar, add tomatoes, fresh coriander, garlic, green chillies, coriander, seeds, pink salt, lemon juice, & blend well.

steps.romanUrdu: -Ek blending jar mein tomatoes, fresh coriander, garlic, green chillies, coriander seeds, pink salt, lemon juice dalein aur achi tarah blend karen.
-Mandi sauce tayyar hai, side par rakh den.

steps.instruction: -In a cooking pot, add cooking oil, heat it, add almonds, fry on medium flame for 1 minute or until golden, take out & set aside.
-In the same cooking oil, add onion, fry on medium flame for 2 minutes, add ginger garlic paste, tomato puree, mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek cooking pot mein cooking oil dalein, garam karen, almonds dalein aur medium flame par 1 minute ya golden hone tak fry karen, phir nikal kar side par rakh den.

steps.instruction: -Add reserved mandi spice mix, dried lemon, mix well, cook on medium flame until oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: -Usi oil mein onion dalein aur medium flame par 2 minutes fry karen.

steps.instruction: -Add water, mix well & bring it to boil, add soaked rice, pink salt, chicken cube, mix well, cook on high flame for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ginger garlic paste dalein, phir tomato puree dalein aur mix karen.

steps.instruction: -Add fried almonds, cover & steam cook for 10-15 minutes with a heat diffuser plate.
steps.romanUrdu: -Reserved mandi spice mix aur dried lemon dalein, mix karen aur medium flame par oil separate hone tak cook karen.

steps.instruction: -In a serving platter, add mandi rice, baked fish, garnish with lemon slices, give a coal smoke & serve with prepared mandi sauce & salad!
steps.romanUrdu: -Water dalein, mix karen aur boil aane den.

steps.instruction: -Soaked rice, pink salt aur chicken cube dalein, mix karen aur high flame par 4–5 minutes cook karen.
-Fried almonds dalein, cover karen aur heat diffuser plate ke sath 10–15 minutes steam cook karen.
-Serving platter mein mandi rice dalein, upar baked fish rakh den.
-Lemon slices se garnish karen, coal smoke den aur tayyar mandi sauce aur salad ke sath serve karen.

ogDescription: Tender baked fish paired with flavorful mandi rice and a smoky touch, best enjoyed with mandi sauce and salad.#FoodFusion #HappyCookingToYou #mandi
